newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SOCCER-BELGIUM CALL UP THREE NEWCOMERS FOR WALES TIE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BELGIUM CALL UP THREE NEWCOMERS FOR WALES TIE.

text.p: Belgium coach Georges Leekens called three newcomers into his 18-man squad on Sunday for next Saturday's World Cup qualifier against Wales in Cardiff.
Leekens drafted strikers Mbo Mpenza of Mouscron and Bob Peeters of Lierse, and midfielder Didier Dheedene of Ekeren.
Two regulars, strikers Marc Wilmots of Schalke O4 and Gert Verheyen of champions and leaders Club Brugge, are injured.
Leekens said he would not aim for a draw against Wales. "That would be suicide against such a team," he said.
He said the match would be important but not decisive for Belgium's chances of reaching the finals. "We'll see more clearly after Turkey-Netherlands early April," he said.
Goalkeepers - Filip De Wilde (Sporting Lisbon), Philippe Vande Walle (Ekeren)
Defenders - Philippe Albert (Newcastle), Bertrand Crasson (Napoli), Bart De Roover (Lierse), Olivier Doll (Anderlecht), Eric Van Meir (Lierse)
Midfielders - Didier Dheedene (Ekeren), Dominique Lemoine (Mouscron), Enzo Scifo (Monaco), Lorenzo Staelens (Club Brugge), Franky Van der Elst (Club Brugge), Nico Van Kerckhoven (Lierse)
Strikers - Mbo Mpenza (Mouscron), Lokonda Mpenza (Mouscron), Luc Nilis (PSV Eindhoven), Luis Oliveira (Fiorentina), Bob Peeters (Lierse)
